summary: High Court converted acquittal into conviction in revision under s.401 CrPC despite statutory bar; no notice to accused; revisionist died before judgment; CrPC s.401(3) prohibits conversion of acquittal to conviction; proceedings violated natural justice, Articles 21, 22(1), 20(3); conviction set aside; acquittal restored.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment converting acquittal into conviction set aside; original acquittal restored; appellants entitled to be released if not already freed.
